info.name: User Limit
info.summary: Blocks user creation past a configurable per-instance ceiling
info.description:
Enforces a hard cap on the total number of users an instance may hold. Hooks BeforeUserCreatedEvent and aborts creation once the configured limit is reached. Applies to the web UI, occ, the provisioning API and the registration app. Default cap is 5; change it at runtime with:
occ config:app:set userlimit limit --value=<N>
Set the value to 0 (or negative) to disable the cap without uninstalling.
info.author: you
